description: This file defines the ConnectionIdInvalidException class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate invalid connection IDs. It includes a builder pattern for creating instances and methods for JSON deserialization.

classes.name: ConnectionIdInvalidException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating an invalid connection ID, immutable, serializable, with builder pattern.

classes.name: ConnectionIdInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing ConnectionIdInvalidException instances with fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for ConnectionIdInvalidException with an optional ID.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ConnectionIdInvalidException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
